newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to off 0.05.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to off 0.05.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged to 0.05 cent lower Monday, dealers said.

Follow-through speculative liquidation is expected to pressure the most-active October contract below support at 11.00 cents a lb, but the bulk of liquidation probably took place on Friday, they added.
Friday, July delivery closed 0.31 cent lower at 11.06 cents, traded 11.38 to 11.05 cents. Most-active October ended down 0.30 cent at 11.03 cents, while the rest settled 0.23 to 0.14 cent weaker.
An estimated 60,109 lots changed hands on the day.
A lack of rain in Thailand could cause a 10 percent reduction in sugar output in the 1997/98 season, the Thai Cane Sugar Board chief, said. Output was seen between 5.0 to 5.2
LIFFE white sugar futures were weaker, with the spot August contract trading below support at $320. Scale down buying from commission houses stymied additional losses.
At 0843 EDT/1243 GMT, August stood down $1.80 to $319.40. The rest of the board was trading $0.90 to $0.50 weaker.
